profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
For the past 4+ years, I've immersed myself in the world of Front-End development, crafting engaging and intuitive user experiences using technologies like React, TypeScript, and Next.js. My journey into software development, however, began with a foundation in Mechanical Engineering, where I honed my problem-solving skills and passion for optimizing processes, including utilizing programming for analysis and automation, leading me to pursue a career change.
   
This shift solidified my passion for the ability to bridge the gap between complex ideas and user-friendly applications. I believe my unique background, combining critical thinking with a passion for creative problem-solving, allows me to approach challenges with a fresh perspective. 

Currently, I am expanding my technical toolkit by engineering a Backend For Front-End (BEFFE) orchestration layer. This project has allowed me to dive deep into Node.js 22 and Apollo Server, specifically focusing on building resilient GraphQL APIs and mastering strict TypeScript ESM configurations. By implementing automated unit testing and interceptor patterns, I am honing my ability to build scalable, type-safe systems that bridge the gap between complex microservices and seamless user experiences.
  
Beyond Front-End development, I'm actively seeking opportunities to learn and grow in all aspects of software engineering and embracing the continuous evolution of this exciting field.  

Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, GraphQL, Python, MATLAB, C++ 
Frameworks: Next.js, Vitest, Jest, Tailwind, Express.js, Flask, Django 
Technologies/Libraries: React, Vite, Material UI, Contentful, React Testing Library, Git, GitLab, GitHub, Node.js, jQuery, PostgreSQL, HTML5, CSS3
  
Personal Site: https://gtor23.github.io/jtorres-portfolio/
Resume: https://gtor23.github.io/jerry-torres-assets/documents/gerardo_jerry_torres_resume.docx.pdf

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop and integrate new shareable components into a custom-built library, playing a key role in the rebuild of a 1000+ location web platform using micro-frontends
• Enhance content management and component visualization by integrating with Contentful and Storybook
• Contribute to maintaining high engineering standards through documentation and code reviews
• Proactively present useful technologies in team meetings, fostering knowledge sharing and innovation
• Regularly demonstrated project progress and new features, ensuring team alignment and transparency 

TypeScript, React, Material UI, Storybook, Contentful, GraphQL and Next.js.

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Utilized Python to develop scripts and GUI applications to automate my daily work tasks and assist customer service representatives
• Designed aluminum molds for plastic thermoforming using SolidWorks
• Generated machine code utilizing Computer Aided Manufacturing software
• Managed and organized transferred tools from other company locations

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineer
positions.description:
• Incorporated automation welding for improved production cycles and product quality
• Programmed Miller robotic welders for MIG welding parts according to engineering prints
• Developed working fixtures that allowed operators to use minimal labor when producing parts
• Designed sheet metal and tubular parts using SolidWorks
• Generated working engineering drawings to complete design prototypes and samples for customers
• Monitored a powder coat line and provided line improvements to ensure products were finished according to product specifications and routings
• Implemented Lean Manufacturing principles when organizing working stations for production of specific products
• Applied root cause analysis to solve various manufacturing issues when running production
• Utilized shop equipment and worked with multiple shop floor staff to complete first piece articles and design prototypes
• Created product assembly and instruction manuals for customer support
• Managed a team of employees to complete field repairs in a different facility

projects.title: Jerry Torres Portfolio
projects.description: Learn more about me and my work on my site, developed using React, TypeScript, Vite, and styled with Tailwind CSS.

projects.title: Spacestagram
projects.description:
Instagram inspired front-end project featuring videos/images provided by NASA's APOD API.

Using NASA's APOD API for videos and images, this project was developed using Node.js followed by React. Incorporating packages such as React-Icons and React-Spinners simplified the process of adding a Like/Unlike button and Loading page while the API's data is returned.

Link to deployment: https://zen-dijkstra-5f21a0.netlify.app/

organizations.name: Engineering World Health
organizations.description: Structural team leader for a laminar flow hood project that was designed for a hospital in Vietnam
